queue.creator: 0x86268c712d63aa2115f763d487af8567087d38c3
queue.name: World Bank Reserve
queue.descr: The reserve behind every currency Building an Onchain Reserve System for Currency Markets A Different Structure for Crypto Markets Crypto became extremely good at creating markets, but very few ecosystems developed a reserve layer behind them. Most systems optimize for launch velocity and speculation, not long-term coordination between markets. World Bank Reserve (WBG) explores a different structure: a reserve-based currency ecosystem where every market contributes back into a shared treasury and reserve layer. At the center of the ecosystem sits WBG/USD, the primary reserve pair. Around it exist child currency markets such as EUR/USD, JPY/USD, GBP/USD, IDR/USD, BRL/USD, and others. Each currency operates independently with its own liquidity, volatility, community, and narrative, but all activity inside the ecosystem still routes value back into the same reserve system.

queue.descr:
① 质押挖积分
把代币押到金库 → 自动累积分红积分(1 积分 = 1 wei BNB)。
② 排雷瓜分
用积分入场 → VRF 随机布雷 → 没踩中地雷的瓜分 80% 奖池,20% 回流给质押者。
③ 赢了才能提
只有赢来的积分能换 BNB 提现,1:1。光躺平不下场,积分只是好看。
